module: GE extension `core_vehicle_partmgmt`: management of parts and configuration of a vehicle during gameplay (configuration menu, tuning). Reads/modifies the config of `core_vehicle_manager.getVehicleData(id).config` (partsTree, vars, paints) and respawns the vehicle (`respawn`) to apply changes, saves/loads/deletes local .pc configs (format 2, with an info_<name>.json file and a .jpg thumbnail), saves vehicle collections (format 4), sends the configurator data to the UI (VehicleConfigChange) and handles part highlighting ("X-ray" rendering with fade). The targeted vehicle is that of core_vehicle_configTarget (otherwise player 0's vehicle); most functions accept an explicit id.
usage:
-- Change the player vehicle's tuning variables without a full respawn
core_vehicle_partmgmt.setConfigVars({['$camber_F'] = 0.1}, true)
-- Save a local config
local res = core_vehicle_partmgmt.saveNewLocalConfig('My config', {generateThumbnail = true, savePaints = true}, nil)
print(res.success, res.fileName)
-- Read a vehicle's config
local cfg = core_vehicle_partmgmt.getConfigOfVehicle(be:getPlayerVehicleID(0))
dump(cfg.partsTree.chosenPartName)
notes: Save settings (saveSettings, table): generateThumbnail (default true), saveLicenseplate (false), savePaints (true), overridePaints (false: writes the paints as explicit paints in the info file), useThumbnailFile + thumbnailFile (provided thumbnail), thumbnailCaptureId (id of a temporary core_vehicle_thumbnail capture). A boolean in place of the table is accepted (legacy withThumbnail argument). The metadata (saveMetadata) is validated by ge/extensions/vehicles/saveConfigUtils.

The functions saveNewLocalConfig / saveExistingLocalConfig return a table {success, reason?, fileName?, displayName?, configSaved?, thumbnailCopied?, metadataError?}. Reasons: walking, noVehicle, invalidFilename, invalidMetadata, saveFailed, thumbnailCopyFailed, configNotFound, notPlayerConfig.
Config paths are relative to the model folder (vehicleDirectory, e.g. 'vehicles/pickup/'). After saving, core_vehicles.clearCache() and ui_vehicleSelector_general.clearCache() are called.

setConfig / setConfigOfVehicle merge (tableMerge) the data into the vehicle's config. With respawn (true by default when nil), the vehicle is recreated via veh:respawn(serialize(config)); with respawn=false, only the paints are updated live (liveUpdateVehicleColors) and the partConfig field is rewritten. The first modification triggers the VEHICLE_MODIFIED achievement outside career.
setPartsConfig is obsolete: it just logs an error and asks to use setPartsTreeConfig. resetPartsToLoadedConfig still calls it, however, so this "Reset" button does nothing (game inconsistency).

Probable BUG: in buildConfigFromString, the inner function preprocessPartConfig returns nothing at the end of the format 4 case (it only has a return for a linked file failure and for the non-format 4 case); a format 4 config passed directly therefore falls back to the model's default config.
saveVehicle (collections) reads a variable `partsCondition` that is never defined in its scope: data.partsCondition is always nil.

M.savePartConfigFileStage2 points to savePartConfigFileStage2_Format2 (signature partsCondition, filename, saveSettings, saveMetadata) and not to the function of the same name (format 4) defined earlier, which is not exported.
No public function to call isOfficialConfig/isPlayerConfig (local): these values are returned by getConfigList (fields official, player).

Highlight functions: if inVehID is nil, the vehicle targeted by core_vehicle_configTarget (or player 0) is used. 'highlight' = eye clicked in the UI (partsHighlighted), 'select' = temporary hover of a part.

xrayFadeRate.desc: Mesh fade speed for the X-ray highlight, in alpha per second (5 by default). Editable from the console: core_vehicle_partmgmt.xrayFadeRate = 5.

getConfigVehicleId.desc: Resolves the id of the vehicle to configure (alias of core_vehicle_configTarget.resolveVehicleId).

explicitVehicleId.desc: requested id; nil = configuration target, otherwise player 0

getTranslation.desc: Translates a UI name: text with a default translation prefix, or a table {txt, ctx} translated with context. Any other table gives nil.

translateTuningData.desc: Copies the tuning variables while translating title, description, category and subCategory.

buildConfigFromString.desc: Builds a vehicle's config table from config data: config table, serialized string starting with '{', or .pc file path. Without a valid config, falls back to default_pc from the model's info file. Format 2 files are merged into the result, otherwise the content becomes `parts`. Called by core_vehicle_manager on spawn.

onlyReturnChosenConfig.desc: if true, returns (nil, false) instead of falling back to the default config

returns.desc: true if the requested config was actually used (not the default fallback)

partsTreeToPartsMap.desc: Flattens a resolved parts tree into a slotId -> chosen part name dictionary (`parts` format of .pc files). Slots with the same id at different paths are recorded under their full path.

compileVehicleCollection.desc: Turns a tree of coupled vehicles (core_vehicles.generateAttachedVehiclesTree) into a list of vehicle configs: computes the relative offsets ('default': x,y,z,rx,ry,rz; 'coupledNodes': rotations only), numbers the parents and saves each vehicle's config (or a linkedPCFile if it comes from a .pc).

saveVehicleCollection.desc: Writes a vehicle collection in format 4 to a JSON file and notifies the UI (VehicleconfigSaved, message).

savePartConfigFileStage2.desc: Saves the targeted vehicle's config in format 2 to `filename` (+ info_<name>.json file + paints according to saveSettings), notifies the UI and empties the selector caches. See the notes on the alias.

saveMetadata.desc: metadata to write in the info file

save.desc: Saves the targeted vehicle's config under a full path (alias of savePartConfigFile -> format 2).

fn.desc: relative file name, with the .pc extension

returns.desc: true if saved; false without a vehicle

saveNewLocalConfig.desc: Saves the config under a new file name derived from configurationName (lowercase, numeric suffix if already taken), generates the thumbnail and unlocks the VEHICLE_CONFIG_SAVED achievement.

saveExistingLocalConfig.desc: Overwrites an existing player config (not an official config).

getSaveAvailability.desc: Indicates whether saving is possible (not on foot, vehicle present).

getSaveMetadataFields.desc: Editable metadata fields for saving (from saveConfigUtils) for the targeted vehicle's model.

setCurrentConfigurationName.desc: Sets the display name (Configuration) in the targeted vehicle's config (without saving).

getCurrentLocalConfigName.desc: Base name (without folder or .pc) of the config loaded in the targeted vehicle.

getConfigList.desc: Lists the .pc files of the targeted vehicle's model folder.

returns.desc: entries {fileName, name, displayName?, official, player, thumbnailPath?}; nil without a vehicle

loadLocal.desc: Replaces the targeted vehicle with the given config (core_vehicles.replaceVehicle with {config = filename}).

removeLocal.desc: Deletes <folder>/<filename>.pc and its .jpg thumbnail then notifies the UI (VehicleconfigRemoved).

savedefault.desc: Saves the targeted vehicle's config as the default vehicle (settings/default.pc) and displays a message.

saveLocalScreenshot.desc: Step 1 of a thumbnail capture: switches to free camera, FOV 35, triggers saveLocalScreenshot_stage1 on the UI side.

fn.desc: file name (not used at this step)

saveLocalScreenshot_stage2.desc: Step 2: takes the jpg capture in the model folder then triggers saveLocalScreenshot_stage3.

sendDataToUI.desc: Sends to the UI (raw guihook VehicleConfigChange) all the configurator data: id, model, chosen parts tree, translated tuning variables, .pc default values, partpacks catalog, highlighted parts, enriched part info.

reset.desc: Resends the data to the UI (sendDataToUI).

hasAvailablePart.desc: Indicates whether a part exists in the targeted vehicle's jbeam context.

setSkin.desc: Applies a skin: chooses the part '<model>_skin_<skin>' in the 'paint_design' slot then replaces the vehicle. An empty skin removes the skin.

setConfigOfVehicle.desc: Merges `inData` into the given vehicle's config (see notes on respawn).

respawn.desc: true (default): recreates the vehicle; false: live paint update

setConfig.desc: Like setConfigOfVehicle for the targeted vehicle (or explicitVehicleId).

setConfigPaints.desc: Merges a list of paints into the config ({paints = data}).

setConfigVars.desc: Merges tuning variables ({vars = data}) into the targeted vehicle's config.

setPartsConfig.desc: Obsolete: logs an error asking to use setPartsTreeConfig. Applies nothing.

setPartsTreeConfig.desc: Applies a new parts tree to the targeted vehicle (merge of {partsTree = dataTree}) and emits the onPartsTreeConfigChanged(dataTree, respawn, part) hook beforehand.

part.desc: part that caused the change (passed to the hook only)

returns.desc: config (not a copy); nil if unknown

getConfig.desc: Current config of the targeted vehicle.

resetConfig.desc: Clears parts and vars of the targeted vehicle's config and recreates the vehicle.

resetAllToLoadedConfig.desc: Reloads the original config (partConfigFilename) of the targeted vehicle.

resetPartsToLoadedConfig.desc: Parts Reset button: re-reads the parts of the original .pc and calls setPartsConfig (obsolete, see notes).

resetVarsToLoadedConfig.desc: Resets the tuning variables to those of the original .pc (empty if none) and recreates the vehicle.

validatePaints.desc: Compares the targeted vehicle's current paints with those of the model/library (core_vehiclePaints.validatePcPaints) and adds the default save settings.

returns.desc: result of validatePcPaints + defaults; {} without a vehicle

getCurrentLicensePlate.desc: License plate text of the targeted vehicle.

setCurrentLicensePlate.desc: Applies a license plate text to the targeted vehicle (core_vehicles.setPlateText).

regenerateCurrentLicensePlate.desc: Generates and applies a new random license plate text.

openConfigFolderInExplorer.desc: Opens the model's configs folder in the file explorer (creates it if it does not exist).

highlightParts.desc: Sets the highlighted parts (click on the UI eye) and applies the corresponding transparency.

parts.desc: [part path] = true for the visible parts

selectParts.desc: Temporary selection (hover of a part in the UI): sets these parts to full visibility and reframes the part camera.

showHighlightedParts.desc: Goes back to displaying the highlighted parts (after a hover).

setHighlightedPartsVisiblity.desc: Sets the transparency of the highlighted parts.

changeHighlightedPartsVisiblity.desc: Changes the transparency of the highlighted parts by a delta (result clamped 0..1).

setNewParts.desc: Updates the highlight data after a parts change: existing parts keep their state, new ones take that of their parent.

silent.desc: true: do not notify the UI

resetVehicleHighlights.desc: Clears the highlights (parts, transparency, camera) by fading back to the opaque vehicle.

onlyIfVehChanged.desc: true: only clears if the vehicle's model changed

clearVehicleHighlights.desc: Immediately removes the X-ray state (restores the alpha) for the given vehicle or all.

releasePartFocusCamera.desc: Gives the camera back to the player (core_vehicle_partFocusCamera.clear).

partsSelectorChanged.desc: Called by the UI when the parts selector's selection changes; delays the application by 0.1 s (debounce) via highlightParts.

sendPartsSelectorStateToUI.desc: Sends to the UI (guihook PartsSelectorUpdate) the sorted list of parts and the highlighted indexes.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook: a vehicle spawns; resets the relevant X-ray state and the part info cache.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook: the target player changes vehicle; clears the X-ray state.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: a vehicle is destroyed; frees its highlight data.

onVehicleConfigTargetChanged.desc: Hook (core_vehicle_configTarget): the configuration target changes; clears the X-ray and sends the new vehicle's data to the UI.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook: the extension is unloaded; restores the meshes' alpha.

onLanguageChanged.desc: Hook: the language changes; empties the translation caches.

onReloadLocales.desc: Hook: translations are reloaded; empties the caches.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: applies the parts selector debounce and animates the X-ray fade.

onFilesChanged.desc: Hook: files changed; empties the saveConfigUtils cache and invalidates the partpacks cache if a .partpacks.json changed.

onSerialize.desc: Hook: saves the highlight data before a Lua reload.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook: restores the data from onSerialize.
